author: KeewiDood
body:
Hello Everyone! 
We bought this new house, and we got a new Wi-Fi (including a new ip-address) and i think someone have used THIS ip-address before, cause it says that my brother is banned for 'ban evading' with 3 accounts, when we only have our own accounts (F2McLarenF2, KevinToyotamr). So i would like you to unban us, since we haven't been using these accounts.


I'm not active on the forums, so i would like you to contact me back through skype or email.
Skype: KevinToyotamr
Email: kevintoyotamr@gmail.com


~KevinToyotamr

title: False Ban?

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey there,

If yourself and your brother could prove that you have no alt accounts under the name Half_Enderman then your ban will be appealed.

However, it doesn't help if your brother excessively spams another moderator on Skype.

- Spoookeh
